scope: Rendered technical review at shown scales: UV/PBR/mip response and gross import artifacts. Existing appearance limitations remain; not whole-V2 photoreal, narrative, gameplay or human acceptance.

images.observation: Tank, masts and windowed masonry masses remain legible; roof stock and distant facade details reduce naturally at this viewing scale.
Recessed sash grids and varied shade states remain distinct across the near elevation; no obvious texture stretch or compression blocks at this view.
Roof apparatus, guy lines and adjoining windowed elevations retain visible silhouette detail under the sky lighting.
Near brick relief responds to grazing light and recessed sash/canopy stock remains separated. Repeated brick wear is still broader appearance work.
Revealed sash, brick/stone transitions and fire-escape geometry remain distinct in the narrow street view.
Sills and lintels project from the masonry with recessed dark sash; the neighbouring facade retains its own finish and value.
Rear window reveals remain visible above the lower distant frontage; this is a posed context view, not route proof.
Lower horizon rows, cornice lines and window grids are visible without the former stepped massing; distant surfaces remain simplified at this scale.
Dry sky state retains readable near masonry and roof apparatus without obvious texture aliasing in this frame.
Storm illumination lowers silhouette contrast while retaining foreground roof details; reviewed as an optical state.
Fog softens distant massing and preserves the near mast/tank silhouettes; no physical-surface exemption is inferred from this view.
Ground/apron joins remain continuous below the masses; dark background elevation detail is limited in this diagnostic angle.
Mounted frame remains above the wood panel cap with a clear wall field; no eye-level rail crosses the fixture in this view.
Small frame remains separated from door casing and lower panel cap; the removed eye-level band no longer crosses its wall field.
Six clipped sheets remain visible with end supports against the clear wall field; panel cap stays below the hanging stock.
Wardrobe panels, reflected carried-light highlight and separation from neighbouring trim/window remain visible; grain follows the vertical doors.
Wall cupboard, upper moulding and faucet remain visible with the clear wall field behind; wood remains distinct from surrounding plaster and metal.
Both retained tubs/wringers and connected supply stock are visible; pipe and fixture surfaces remain distinct under the carried light.
Continuous restored frontage, inset door, marquee/brackets and distinct sash/blind states remain visible. Door illumination and brick repetition remain appearance polish.
